 Television DC Correspondent 7 Nov 2026 10:11 AM IST 7 Nov 2026 10:11 AM IST There will be no elimination this weekend due to the Diwali festival.
 x As Preferred
Source Actor Salman Khan is back on the Bigg Boss sets to grill the contestants in this weekend’s episode. Whispers are circulating on social media that the makers are likely to skip elimination for the week. Yes, you read that right. 
 There will be no elimination this weekend due to the Diwali festival.
 The show's makers are planning Diwali celebrations for the contestants instead.
 It remains to be seen how accurate this news is, so let's wait for an official confirmation from the makers.
 Bigg Boss 20 airs on Colors TV and streams on Jio Hotstar.
